old_problem: The historical record retained Pending/BLOCKED because Master Procedure and Criteria are TBD and an undefined receive switch could expose or flood the BMC. IPMI v2.0 section 22.5 defines the optional App command 0x32, channel-number request, enable/disable/get states and response readback. Exact target channel, authorized bounded producer and Project security limits remain configuration inputs, not missing core command semantics.
disposition_reason: Preserve the Master TBD history and the actual enable coverage. Discover and bind one concrete supported channel, capture its baseline with state 0x02, obtain immediate approval for the attack-surface change, enable it with state 0x01, prove one bounded authorized message enters the Receive Message Queue, and restore the captured baseline with state 0x00 when it was originally disabled. Never enable every channel, guess OEM routing/authentication, flood the queue, drain unrelated messages or retry an uncertain write.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1006, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 1007 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 1007 / variant 59cec46fd595a3c6.

IPMI v2.0 section 22.5 and Table 22-6 define optional App command 0x32. Request byte 1 contains the channel number; request byte 2 low two bits select disable 00b, enable 01b or get state 10b, with all reserved bits zero.

The response echoes the channel and reports disabled/enabled state. The specification states the control governs reception into the Receive Message Queue for that channel and does not affect SMS message transmission.

The standard warns that message reception may be disabled to protect against erroneous or malicious flooding and recommends Destination Unavailable for rejected inbound requests. Therefore sender authorization, a strict message/rate bound, queue/health monitoring and prompt baseline restoration are mandatory Project inputs.

ED-03, ED-05, ED-15, ED-17 through ED-19, ED-24, ED-26 through ED-30 permit parameterization of channel/security/runtime bindings while preserving the named enable function; ED-33 through ED-38 preserve TBD/OEM uncertainty and forbid broad mutation or blind retry.

test_case.test_name: Enable reception on one approved IPMI message channel, prove bounded authorized delivery, and restore baseline
test_case.purpose: Verify that one SPEC-supported BMC messaging channel can be explicitly enabled for receive, accepts only the approved bounded test traffic into the Receive Message Queue, preserves BMC health and unrelated channel state, and is returned to its captured baseline.
required_package: Immutable DUT/BMC/interface identity, firmware version, pinned ipmitool/raw-response parser and protected App 0x32 runner
Project channel binding derived from authoritative channel inventory: exact numeric channel, medium/protocol, support for Set/Get Message Channel Receive, persistence expectation and owner
Approved sender/route/authentication policy and a separate bounded producer fixture containing the exact benign message, count, maximum rate and audit-copy retention
Receive Message Queue evidence method paired to the separately reviewed Get Message case, with correlation token and protection against consuming unrelated production/incident messages
Per-channel queue depth/health/CPU/alert thresholds, maintenance window, independent OOB observer, immediate approval and incident/restore runbook
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind one concrete supported channel `<ch>` from authoritative inventory; do not use an ambiguous current-channel shortcut. Preserve channel/routing/auth, Receive Message Queue and BMC health baseline. Query state once with `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x32 <ch> 0x02`; require echoed `<ch>`, valid state and reserved bits zero. Show the exact target, authorized producer, one-message/rate limit, monitoring and captured restore state, then obtain point-of-action confirmation. Enable once using `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x32 <ch> 0x01`; capture completion and immediate 0x02 readback. Send only the pre-approved correlated benign message from the separately controlled sender. Prove its queue arrival/receipt through the paired Get Message evidence path without draining unrelated data, while recording queue/BMC/alert health and unchanged unrelated channels. Stop the producer. If baseline was disabled, restore once with `<ch> 0x00`; otherwise preserve enabled baseline. Verify final 0x02 state and health. Never enable all channels, alter routing/auth, use OEM payloads, clear logs/queues, flood, reset/power cycle, or retry an uncertain state change.
test_case.expected_result: The selected supported channel has a valid captured baseline, the single approved enable completes and reads back enabled, exactly the bounded authorized correlated message is demonstrably received through that channel, no unauthorized/unrelated traffic or health/queue/alert breach occurs, and final state matches the captured baseline. Unsupported/no-op behavior is not PASS.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact channel/support evidence, approved sender and traffic envelope, immediate confirmation, completion 00 plus valid echoed-channel/state readback, correlated receive evidence, unchanged unrelated configuration, health within pre-approved thresholds and exact baseline restoration. Command success alone, missing queue evidence, a message from an unbound path, queue drain, guessed channel/OEM semantics, absent threshold, unexpected traffic, ambiguous completion, retry or failed restore cannot pass. Missing Project bindings is NOT READY rather than Engineering Decision Pending.
safety_gate: Require point-of-action confirmation after displaying the exact channel, medium/protocol, baseline state, sender/auth route, bounded message/rate, health limits and inverse restore request.
Change exactly one supported channel. Never enable all channels, reserved/unknown channels or an OEM routing/authentication mode inferred from the title.
Use one benign correlated message or the Project-approved stricter bound; never perform load/flood testing or send secrets/destructive payloads in this case.
Preserve audit/log/queue evidence before mutation. Do not clear logs or queues and do not consume unrelated messages merely to prove this case.
Use independent OOB observation; stop the producer and execute the pre-approved baseline restore on threshold, unexpected traffic or management degradation.
No automatic retry after timeout or uncertain enable/disable completion. Read state under the approved verification step, preserve ambiguity and escalate.
expected_evidence: Master TBD snapshot, authoritative channel inventory/support entry, exact target/firmware/tool/parser and Project policy revision
Raw pre-state 0x32 get response, decoded echoed channel/state/reserved bits, routing/auth/queue/BMC health baseline and unrelated-channel inventory
Immediate approval, exact one-channel enable request/response, enabled readback and no-retry audit
Authorized producer audit copy with correlation token/count/rate plus paired receive/queue evidence and timestamps
Queue/BMC/alert health timeline, unexpected-traffic check, producer-stop proof, restore request/response, final state/health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop the approved producer first. If command completion is known and baseline was disabled, issue the single pre-approved 0x32 disable request for the same numeric channel, then verify state and BMC health from the independent path. If completion is uncertain, do not resend blindly: read state once under the approved verification plan, preserve all evidence and let the owner decide the single recovery action. On unexpected traffic, queue saturation or management degradation, isolate the producer/path, preserve logs/messages and escalate; do not clear evidence, reset/power cycle or broaden the change.

source_conflict.reason: The protected Master remains TBD, but the named optional IPMI operation has a complete standard enable/disable/get schema and observable receive behavior. One discovered supported channel plus approved security/traffic bindings yields a reviewable acceptance contract without guessing OEM routing.

blocked.reason: Core command semantics and inverse operation are authoritative. Exact channel, sender/auth route, traffic bound, health thresholds and message fixture are finite Project runtime prerequisites with an explicit safety gate.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Section 22.5, Table 22-6 and Appendix G define optional App 0x32, channel/state request fields, disable/enable/get encodings, response state, Receive Message Queue scope, transmit non-effect and flood-protection rationale.

project_authority: The Project BMC/security owner selects a SPEC-supported channel, defines its authenticated route and exact bounded producer, supplies measurable queue/health/alert limits, approves point-of-action enable and owns incident response. OEM routing or authentication semantics require vendor authority; Project configuration cannot redefine reserved standard fields.
